name: Atlas
description: Photographs every screen of a workspace's web app, empty and with data, light and dark, the same way every time, as a gallery and an app map. The project's atlas.json says how to start it. The first run downloads a pinned headless Chromium (about 100 MB).

settings.label: Pictures folder
settings.description: Where the full-size pictures go. Empty keeps them in the extension's folder inside COGNIX[WS]'s data folder.

settings.label: Worlds at once
settings.description: How many copies of the app run side by side during a run.
